and the server SQL. A clone is its source's Map.dbc row with a new ID and name and the same Directory, so the
looks_comment: A clone's look (lightdata.py, wmofog.py): its own global light, copied from its source map's and turned into a
thick fog whose colour is also the sky's. fog_end_yd must stay under 27.8 (longer turns into a haze); the
source's WMOs with more than one fog entry go into the patch with one, so the map fog shows inside them too.
Light ids 2600 + (clone - 900), LightParams 950 + 2 * (clone - 900) and the next one.
